task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
An underwater shot captures a rocky reef structure over a sandy bottom, with the camera tilting upward to reveal the rock face. The scene is characterized by a pale, turquoise-green water tint and dappled sunlight casting distinct, wavy shadows of the rock onto the light-colored sand below. The rock itself is heavily encrusted with marine growth, including patches of bright red algae or coral, small white shells, and a prominent, circular, yellowish-orange organism with a dark center embedded in the rock face. A small, dark fish swims near the base of the rock in the initial frames before the camera's upward movement brings the textured, colorful rock surface into full view.
